perf.summary: Bitfield masks recomputed inline and duplicated across getter/setter instead of named constants.
perf.currentCost: Each accessor recomputes ((1u << Recast.RCSpanHeightBits) - 1) and shifted variants; the height mask and Area mask 0x3F are duplicated between getter and setter. RCSpanHeightBits is const so the JIT folds these, but the duplication invites drift in a layout that must match C++ rcSpan.
perf.proposedChange: Add named constants (e.g. in Recast.Constants.cs): const uint RCSpanHeightMask = (1u << RCSpanHeightBits) - 1; const uint RCSpanAreaMask = 0x3F; const int RCSpanAreaShift = RCSpanHeightBits * 2; and use them in all six accessor expressions.
perf.rationale: No codegen change (constants fold identically) but removes duplicated magic-number derivations and the risk of an inconsistent mask between getter and setter; improves auditability.
perf.risk: None — constant folding yields identical IL/Burst output. Verify the new constants equal the inlined expressions.
